findings.body: The previously reported issue remains. When a newer release exists, `upgrade.release_notice` prepends its announcement (src/forge/upgrade.py:186–187), and `machine_next` selects the first non-Next line. Consequently, `forge next --json` returns the release announcement as `next.line`, hiding the actual waiting or human-only merge state when `next.command` is null. Build the machine next object from `_report`'s lines and keep release notices separate.
findings.title: Keep release notices from replacing next.line
